stories.title: Big Ten, SEC add support to college sports bill
stories.summary: The Big Ten and SEC agreed Friday night to support a Senate bill that seeks to regulate college sports.

stories.title: FIFA scraps World Cup sell-off plan after backlash
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino scrapped his proposal to sell stakes in the World Cup after widespread backlash, including from within global soccer's governing body, and a threatened boycott by European nations.

stories.title: Giants suspend pay to Bader after scooter crash
stories.summary: The Giants are suspending payment to injured outfielder Harrison Bader after he aggravated his injured left foot during a scooter accident last weekend.

stories.title: Cunningham unconcerned about being a distraction
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham says she's unconcerned that the rallies against transgender participation in women's sports that have accompanied the Indiana Fever's recent games are a distraction for the WNBA team.

stories.title: Court hands NCAA major loss on new 5-for-5 rule
stories.summary: A federal court dealt a major blow to the NCAA's new eligibility rule when it ruled that all high school class of '22 athletes who exhausted their fourth season of college eligibility this spring are eligible for a fifth season this school year.
